title: Local Lipschitz bounds along a segment give the global bound (parent step 6a)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P (Euclid P), x, y ∈ ℝ^P and K ≥ 0. Suppose that for every t ∈ [0, 1], with w_t := x + t(y − x), there is a neighbourhood U of w_t such that |f(w) − f(w_t)| ≤ K|w − w_t| for all w ∈ U. Then |f(y) − f(x)| ≤ K|y − x|.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (x y : Euclid P) (K : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (x + t • (y - x)), dist (f w) (f (x + t • (y - x))) ≤ K * dist w (x + t • (y - x))) → dist (f y) (f x) ≤ K * dist y x
